newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus subsidiary seeks bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: Optimus subsidiary seeks bourse listing.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA wants to place its 88.3-percent-owned cash register producer Optimus Inter Commerce SA (Optimus IC) on the Warsaw bourse, Optimus's financial director said on Wednesday.

Stefan Mroczek told Reuters there was no decision yet on whether Optimus IC would issue new shares or if the parent company would sell some of its shares before the bourse listing or when the subsidiary would start public trade.

"There is a decision that Optimus IC would be placed on the bourse but there is no decision on when, and whether there will be a new issue or Optimus will sell its shares will depend on the capital situation of the firm (Optimus IC)," he said.
He added Optimus IC would seek a main market listing.
Mroczek said Optimus would like to keep a majority stake in Optimus IC after the company becomes public but said it was possible Optimus SA would later lower its stake in the firm.
Optimus IC made a net profit of 10.7 million zlotys last year on 81.8-million-zloty sales and has about 30 percent of the Polish cash register market.
